coverage: Hanson shots only for categories 0 and 1; category 2 is the rwm_candidates screen on the matched comparison shots, which are unlabelled and not negatives. Only the raw onset points are verified; reviewed negative coverage is unknown even on Hanson shots.

rules.present: the 20 ms before each listed onset, of either mode number (conventional weak annotation motivated by tau_w, not a measured growth interval; see outputs/labeler/rwm/growth.json)
rules.absent: the high-current window (Ip at least half its peak) outside [onset - 100, onset + 100] ms of every listed onset; the precursor before a growth window and the aftermath carry no row (not assessed). Assumed absent: assumes complete onset listing on Hanson shots, without verified negative coverage
rules.uncertain: rwm_candidates screen spans, comparison shots only

evidence_tiers.conventional_weak: 20 ms pre-onset convention, not expert-verified extent
evidence_tiers.assumed_absent: Hanson time away from onsets; completeness assumption
evidence_tiers.unlabelled_screen: screen candidates on comparison shots; not negatives
